method.oof: GroupKFold(5) by task_id on the train split; ridge+Platt and the 64-unit MLP refit per fold with decision_readout helpers
method.test_features: deployed heads (fit on full train, test tasks disjoint from train)
method.fusion: single logistic regression on standardized logits, fit on train OOF, one test pass
method.with_self_note: self-176B features are fit on whatever train rows they exist on: the frozen community/jbench heads now cover all 1,133 train rows (Window B), the clean harvest refit covers the 871 harvest train rows
method.self_domain_note: 176b-own-community was fit on scion176b-community train tasks; in-domain / clean slices split every test item by task overlap. self-harvest is the Window B refit (train and test tasks disjoint).
